svg.title: Ordinary thermal-burn first-aid action card
svg.desc: Working Australian burn card in three parts. First keep out of fire, toxic air and live electricity. If the person is unresponsive and not breathing normally, call Triple Zero and start CPR before skin care. Call Triple Zero for breathing trouble, smoke or facial or throat burns, deep or large burns, electrical or chemical burns, or doubt that the burn is significant. Chemical, electrical and smoke or inhalation injuries need their own emergency route; this card continues only for an ordinary external heat burn once the scene is safe. Cool the burned area with cool running water for at least 20 minutes as soon as possible; cooling may still help when started within three hours. Remove rings, watches, jewellery and wet loose clothing only when they are not stuck. Keep the rest of the person warm. No running-water route in this card authorises untreated natural water or sets a scarce drinking-water allocation. After cooling, cover loosely with a sterile non-stick dressing when available, or clean dry non-fluffy material without a kit. Do not wrap tightly, cover the face, use ice, creams, oils, toothpaste or plant paste, burst blisters, peel stuck material or substitute gel for proper cooling. Keep watching response, normal breathing and warmth. If Triple Zero will not connect, keep care going and use Chapter 3 without leaving the person merely to seek reception.
svg.text: HEAT BURN — DANGER AND HELP FIRST
WORKING CARD · PART 1 OF 3
BURNS AND REMOTE-CARE REVIEW STILL REQUIRED
Estimates: core source wording 95%; remote boundaries 70%;
new layout 60%. These do not estimate safety, success or survival.
Use all three parts together. Follow 000 and current specialist advice.
FIRE, TOXIC AIR OR LIVE ELECTRICITY?
Do not enter or touch. Move away or isolate power only if safe.
Call 000. Do not create a second casualty.
NOT RESPONDING AND NOT BREATHING NORMALLY?
Gasping or uncertainty counts. Call 000. Use a firm surface.
Start CPR now. Do not delay CPR to cool the skin.
CALL 000 NOW
Breathing trouble; smoke, face or throat burn; deep or large burn;
electrical or chemical burn; or any doubt the burn is significant.
Ordinary external heat burn in a safe scene? Continue. Other mechanisms need their own route.
WORKING DRAFT — CONTINUE TO PART 2
COOL THE BURNED AREA
WORKING CARD · PART 2 OF 3
ORDINARY EXTERNAL HEAT BURN ONLY
Chemical, electrical and smoke/inhalation injuries do not use this card
as their complete treatment. Follow 000, Poisons and exact hazard advice.
COOL RUNNING WATER — AT LEAST 20 MINUTES
Start as soon as possible. Time the cooling.
Keep cool running water on the burned area for 20 minutes.
Cooling may still help when started within 3 hours.
Never use ice. Gel does not replace proper water cooling.
No running water? Use clean cool liquid if available; see the limit below.
REMOVE ONLY WHAT IS NOT STUCK · KEEP THE REST WARM
• Remove rings, watches, jewellery and wet loose clothing if not stuck.
• Never pull away material stuck to the burn.
• Protect every unburned area. Children and large burns cool quickly.
No approved scarce-water quantity or untreated-creek substitute is supplied.
WORKING DRAFT — CONTINUE TO PART 3
AFTER COOLING — COVER AND WATCH
WORKING CARD · PART 3 OF 3
KEEP THE COVER LOOSE
Do not wrap around a limb, bind tightly, or put a covering over the face.
This card gives no cling-film method and no chemical-burn covering method.
WITH A KIT
After cooling, place a sterile
non-stick dressing loosely.
Keep the rest of the person
warm without covering the face.
WITHOUT A KIT
After cooling, use clean, dry,
non-fluffy material loosely.
Do not improvise powders, pastes,
oils or a tight bandage.
DO NOT
• use ice, butter, oil, toothpaste, cream or plant paste
• burst blisters, peel stuck material or touch the injured surface
• treat chemical, electrical or inhalation injury as an ordinary burn
KEEP WATCHING AND REPORT CHANGES
Recheck response, normal breathing and warmth. Record the cause and times.
000 will not connect? Keep care going; use Chapter 3. Do not leave merely for signal.
NOT FIELD-APPROVED · USE ALL PARTS WITH THE CHAPTER WARNING
